_meta.about: Real-world dimensions of the Guimarães landmarks, for authoring the procedural models at 1:1 metres. Every numeric leaf under footprint_m, height_m, elements and facade_azimuth_deg has an entry in sources[] (by path). An entry has either a url (published figure or OSM tag) or source:'estimate' with reasoning.
_meta.units: metres unless the key says otherwise; heights are above the local ground at the main entrance
_meta.facade_azimuth_deg: compass direction (0-360, clockwise from north) that the main facade looks towards. footprints.json bearing_deg is a folded long axis in [0,180) and cannot say which end is the front; facade_axis_rel says how the azimuth relates to it.
_meta.osm_geometry: extent_m, edge lengths and edge normals were measured from data/guimaraes/footprints.json outlines with scripts/geo-lib.mjs minAreaRect/toXY; ground heights from data/guimaraes/terrain.json (EU-DEM 25 m).
